prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "For best results, use well-lit photos facing forward.", "Choose high quality photo", "Tip: Avoid blurry or dimly lit photos to ensure pet generation succeeds."]
1: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Choose your preferred sign-in provider below. Having trouble loading?", "Continue with OAuth", "Sign In via Browser Fallback"]
2: ["Review & Confirm Your Pet", "Check your pet details before we create your companion."]
3: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop", "Learn how your pet interacts with your desktop icons and taskbar."]
4: ["Pick Your Pet's Playstyle", "Choose active for a lively buddy that plays on desktop, or relaxed for a calm background companion. You can adjust this anytime."]
5: ["Creating pet model...", "Play chime when finished"]
6: ["Your Pet is Ready to Play!", "Click on your pet to hear its voice and start building your bond.", "Listen to Pet Bark"]
7: ["Returning user? Be sure to sign in with the exact same account you used before to keep your existing pet!"]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate Sealed"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Story", "Discover how a desktop pet brightens your workday."]
